Shareholder Tam Capital Management Raised Boardwalk Pipeline Partners (BWP) Stake; Appleton Partners Stake in Apple Com (AAPL) Trimmed by $418,836 as Share Price Rose
June 21, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Appleton Partners Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 1.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Appleton Partners Inc sold 2,508 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 142,795 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $23.96M, down from 145,303 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Appleton Partners Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $917.26B market cap company. The stock increased 0.06% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $186.62. About 6.01 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
